fact: The Minister said on 21 February 2023 that the 2014 Regulations under the Registration and Identification of Persons Act were amended by GN 96 of 17 February 2023, adding regulation 17A on data-sharing contracts with NIDA and removing card expiry, and that the NIN uniquely identifies each citizen.
title: Serikali Yafuta Ukomo wa Matumizi ya Kitambulisho cha Taifa
